name: limit-status
description: Feeds Claude Code's live usage to LimitSwitcher after every turn, adds /limits (every Claude account at a glance), runs the Jev compaction LimitSwitcher asks for before a swapped session goes on (with the jev-compact plugin), and toasts when a used-up limit has room again.

statePath.title: LimitSwitcher state file
statePath.description: The file LimitSwitcher keeps its local address and token in (set when it installs this mod).
